│ How should acme roll out the new checkout?                                    
│ 1. The old flow stays behind a flag for a week.
│ 2. Support wants a heads-up before any change customers can see, and release  
│ notes go out on Mondays.                                                    
│ 3. Mobile ships on its own schedule.
                                                                              
  1. Flag first (Recommended)
     Ship behind the flag, turn it on for staff, then everyone.
  2. All at once
     Turn it on for everyone on release day.
  3. Wait
     Hold until mobile is ready too.
❯ 4. Flag first, but keep the flag on for staff only until the support team has
     had a full Monday with the new flow. If the error rate on payment          
     confirmation goes above half a percent at any point, turn the flag off and
     tell the channel before anything else.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  5. Chat about this
